result.note: Tests India's first-ever FATF vice-presidency (June 2026) and the body's anti-money-laundering role.

questions.prompt: In June 2026, India took up a leadership position in the Financial Action Task Force (FATF). Consider the following statements:
items: India had held the FATF vice-presidency on earlier occasions before June 2026.
The FATF is a global body that sets anti-money-laundering rules of scrutiny.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 1 is wrong because India took the FATF vice-presidency for the first time in June 2026. The role gives New Delhi advance visibility and a voice as the global anti-money-laundering body writes its rules of scrutiny.
questions.source: India took the Financial Action Task Force vice-presidency for the first time, giving New Delhi advance visibility and a voice as the global anti-money-laundering body writes the rules of scrutiny.
